content.comment_body: Hello, I’m new to programming [company_name] [product_name] controllers, though I have made modifications to existing programs. I want to trigger a 24V warning light after a specific number of cycles (each cycle is activated by a door switch). I’m considering either counting the door openings or tracking the runtime of an extractor motor that starts with the door. We already have a reset button installed, and I’d like to use it to switch off the warning light. Any guidance on how to achieve this would be appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]
Please upload your current program as a ZIP file and explain precisely what changes you’d like to make.

Hello, I’ve attached the program. I’d like to add a warning light using our spare output (Q4) on the PLC. The idea is for Q4 to activate when Q1 has run for around 200 hours, and only switch off when the booth is reset (turned off and on again). Is this achievable? Best regards, [user_name]

I’m unable to interpret your program without a proper functional description. For now, I have programmed the feature to set a memory bit (B021) once 200 hours are reached, which activates output Q4. You’ll need to handle resetting B021 yourself.
Thank you for your assistance. Best regards, [user_name]
Yes, this resolves my issue. I'll add another reset button to my panel as an input for resetting the timers/flag. Thanks for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: The user, inexperienced with [product_name] PLCs, needs a method to count cycles or log runtime before activating a warning signal. The solution involved modifying the program to utilize a spare output for a warning light after a set runtime, plus ensuring a reset mechanism is in place. This exchange highlights how newcomers can struggle with integrating new logic and the importance of clear documentation for support.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a straightforward way to track either motor runtime or cycles and activate a warning light after reaching a threshold, plus to use the existing reset button for clearing the warning condition.
